$Comment: Names the ziggfreedcommon:reputation_rank reading for requirement lines. Param is a reputation id and a rank id joined by a slash (Your_Traders/Friendly); the reading is 1 while the player's standing, gear included, is at or above that rank's floor and 0 below it. Write Min 1 to require the rank. To make a lock line read 'Requires Friendly with the Traders', ship a Factors file of your own with a ParamNames Keys entry for that exact Param.
